## Clip Engine 1.0.1

A sharper journal, livelier motion, and fixes.

- **Clips for every run.** Each run in the **Journal** links to the clips saved during it. The summary shows how your last ten runs went against your overall extraction rate, and the page lists the items you find and lose most. Making it out of a map for the first time is marked as a record.
- **Sharper ARC Raiders raids.** The results screen is read better: XP and kills count once even when the screen counts up or is read twice, ARC assists and knocked-out raiders are picked up, and a raid whose ending was missed is closed by its results screen, so the next raid starts clean. Backpack tooltips no longer show up as items. Tarkov and Helldivers 2 results are counted more reliably too.
- **Livelier motion.** With Ultra's adaptive themes, a soft light follows your pointer, each page scans in as you open it, and the side rail, chips and switches snap as they take. The website moves too. Turn it off with **Motion** in Settings > Plan, or the Motion button on the website. Nothing moves behind a game or when Windows' animation effects are off.
- **Fixes.** A map's extraction rate only counts runs that ended. XP shown on the results line is no longer dropped. A kill you log by hand no longer seems to undo itself when the journal refreshes.

New here? Download `Clip_Engine-Setup.exe` and run it. If you already have Clip Engine, update from Settings.
